description: Change some files of a custom theme (Pro plan) as one new commit: files maps path → whole new text (null deletes), edits are find/replace changes. Read the current files with theme_pull first. Same validation and background compile as theme_upload. On the LIVE theme the change goes live automatically once compiled; theme_rollback undoes it. On the system theme id lokand-base it creates a new unpublished theme from it; pass publish: true to make that live too.

edits.description: Find/replace changes inside existing files. Prefer this over whole files: send only the lines that change

find.description: Exact text that occurs once in the file

files.description: path → whole new file text, or null to delete the file

publish.description: Go live once compiled (always the case when editing the live theme)

theme_id.description: A theme id from theme_list (or the system theme id lokand-base)

name: theme_write_files
title: Theme write files
